subject: Transfer Learning
source_sentence: Transfer learning for multilingual Neural Machine Translation (NMT) attempts to improve the NMT performance on the source to target language pair (child task) using an assisting source language (assisting to target language translation is the parent task).
title: Rudra Murthy V†, Anoop Kunchukuttan‡, Pushpak Bhattacharyya†

subject: BPE
source_sentence: Several studies have tried to address the lexical divergence between the source and the target languages either by using Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) as basic input representation units or character-level NMT system or bilingual embeddings.
title: Rudra Murthy V†, Anoop Kunchukuttan‡, Pushpak Bhattacharyya†

subject: NMT
source_sentence: For NMT, Ponti et al. (2018) and Kawara et al. (2018) have explored pre-ordering.
title: Rudra Murthy V†, Anoop Kunchukuttan‡, Pushpak Bhattacharyya†

subject: Pre-ordering
source_sentence: Pre-ordering the source language sentences to match the target language word order has been found useful in addressing word-order divergence for Phrase-Based SMT.
title: Rudra Murthy V†, Anoop Kunchukuttan‡, Pushpak Bhattacharyya†

subject: Pre-ordering
source_sentence: pre-ordering the assisting language to match the word order of the source language significantly improves translation quality in an extremely low-resource setting.
title: Rudra Murthy V†, Anoop Kunchukuttan‡, Pushpak Bhattacharyya†

subject: fine-tuning
source_sentence: If pre-ordering is not possible, fine-tuning on a small source-target parallel corpus is sufficient to overcome word order divergence.
title: Rudra Murthy V†, Anoop Kunchukuttan‡, Pushpak Bhattacharyya†

subject: Pre-ordering
source_sentence: use of pre-ordering to address word-order divergence for multilingual training of other NLP tasks can be explored.
